onyxExtensionDomain.title: NorthWrit root domain
onyxExtensionDomain.description: Root URL of the NorthWrit instance (for example https://cloud.onyx.app). When set by policy, users cannot change it in the extension.

onyxExtensionDefaultNewTab.title: Use NorthWrit as new tab page
onyxExtensionDefaultNewTab.description: Force the new tab override on (true) or off (false). When set by policy, users cannot change the toggle in the extension.
